title: MISSION 03: A Mother's Weak Spot
briefing:
Target: Manager Choi Sujin, Finance Team
Difficulty: ★★★☆☆

Goal: Manager Choi's finance system account password

Notes:
- Meticulous and prickly. She shuts you down at once if you rush her or ask outright.
- Word is she has a soft spot when it comes to her daughter.
- It's closing season and she is worn out from overtime.

request.subject: Overseas service fee not in the books
request.body:
Please look into the overseas consulting fee processed by the Finance Team.

Check whether the contract matches the payment record, and what service was actually provided.

There may be things that cannot be confirmed from the official closing documents alone. If the person in charge kept a separate record, please confirm that it exists and what it says.

Please also check whether the figures in the closing documents match the money that actually moved.

— K

npc.name: Choi Sujin
npc.persona: Manager on the CorpX Finance Team, age 42. Meticulous and prickly, she cannot stand people who do sloppy work. With someone she has just met she gives short, businesslike answers: clipped replies such as "Yes." and "Fine.", and "Let's keep it to work." when pushed. Her sixth-grade daughter is the most precious thing in the world to her, and when her daughter comes up she warms into longer sentences. Lately she works late because of the closing, and it weighs on her that she cannot spend time with her daughter.

wary: Who did you say you were?
You have a lot of questions today.
angry: What do you think you're doing?
If this keeps up, I'll check with the Security Team.

facts.label: Manager Choi's work
facts.text: I am a manager on the Finance Team. I handle the corporate account and the quarterly closing.

facts.label: Daughter
facts.text: I have a sixth-grade daughter, {{dname_ko}}. She is good at English and I am proud of her.

facts.label: Her situation lately
facts.text: The closing keeps me working late and I hardly see my daughter. That is what upsets me most.

facts.label: Daughter's birthday
facts.text: {{dname_ko}}'s birthday is {{bday_ko}}. I take annual leave that day no matter what.

clues.label: Security check result
clues.keyword: lowercase English name + 4 digits + two special characters (!!)

clues.label: Mail to her husband
clues.text: She always builds her password from "our princess's name" and "the day"
clues.keyword: our princess's name and the day

clues.label: Daughter's name
clues.text: Sixth grader Choi {{dname_cap}} won the school English speaking contest

inferences.label: The name in the password
inferences.yields: "Our princess" is her daughter {{dname_cap}}. The password contains the daughter's English name and "the day". That day must be special to the daughter.

emails.subject: [Finance Team] Regular security check result
emails.body: Manager Choi Sujin, your account has used the same password for five years. Your current password follows the policy format of lowercase English name + 4 digits + two special characters (!!), but please change it without fail within this quarter.

emails.subject: RE: Did you change your password?
emails.body: They told me to change it, so I only pretended to. Same as always, our princess's name and the day. How could I ever forget that.

emails.subject: [School Newsletter] School English Speaking Contest Results
emails.body: Dear parents, we have posted the results of the school English speaking contest in the school website's news section (www.hanbit-es.kr/news). Please give a round of applause to every student who took part.

emails.subject: Quarterly closing schedule
emails.body: The closing deadline for this quarter is November 29. We will handle the overseas service item after the CEO has reviewed it.

emails.subject: [Ad] Elementary winter English camp enrollment
emails.body: Early registration discount for the winter vacation English camp. The 6th grade class is almost full.
